name: Johan Van Overtveldt - Proposition de résolution
title: REPORT on safeguarding and promoting financial stability amid economic uncertainties
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its views on keeping the EU's financial system stable during uncertain times. It asks for a stronger single market for capital, closer watching of non-bank lenders such as money market funds and hedge funds, and better tools to handle crises. It also calls for monitoring risks from crypto, cyber attacks, high government debt and trade tensions. This is an opinion only; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to review rules and propose reforms.
- **Who it affects:** Banks, non-bank lenders, crypto firms, supervisors and savers.
- **Next step:** The Commission decides whether to act on these requests.
